summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on October 9, 2026, announcing a $3.7 million private placement of 989,301 ordinary shares or equivalents plus unregistered warrants for up to 1,483,952 shares at a combined price of $3.74 per share, led primarily by existing investors. Warrants carry a $3.74 exercise price, are immediately exercisable, and expire five years after an effective registration statement. H.C. Wainwright and Rodman & Renshaw serve as joint placement agents; closing is expected on or about October 14, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Proceeds fund LightSolver's laser-based supercomputing R&D and working capital, under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exemptions.
